    secrets:

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable browser game from a garbled prompt: "ILLUSION COMPLEX — TO THE MOON", a 35-level extreme-difficulty illusion platformer with an in-game ad campaign system, credits/diamonds economy, and secret meta finale.

## Requirements
- 35 levels, extreme difficulty, "illusion complex" theme, "to the moon" progression.
- Include an ad campaign running inside the game.
- Level 13: large annoying frog may pop up near the end, can reset the level; level must take ~5× as long as others.
- Level 34: a quick (~0.2s) very bright, shaking crude phallus flash with no gameplay effect ("it'll dangle with no effect... as its time settles").
- Final level (35): futuristic, "cracks the game", nearly impossible to reach; reaching its final moment resets the game. This twist must be undisclosed to players.
- Before the glitch implosion at the finale, use mega annoying, bright-colour effects.
- Add credits and diamond systems.
- No clarifying questions; note assumptions at finish. Uncommitted work in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround`.

## Decisions
- Vanilla JS + Canvas 2D, no build step, static `index.html`.
- 5 districts × 7 levels; phase-swap (A/B), gravity flip, spikes/saws/lasers, crumble/blink tiles, checkpoints, ad billboards, gems.
- Credits (₡) from ad clicks/level rewards; diamonds (◆) from level gems/cosmetics.
- Last level unlock requires all 34 prior clears; finishing it wipes save (cycle counter survives) and reloads.
- Level geometry declared as rectangles; offline A* solver uses identical physics (`js/physics.js`).

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html`, `styles.css` built (screens: title, level select, ADSPACE, how-to, pause, complete, ending, sponsored-ad overlay, touch controls).
- Physics module, 35 level definitions (including redesigned long frog level 13 and hard secret level 35), level builder with auto-gem placement, renderer, audio synth, save system, campaign/ad economy, credits/diamonds UI, main game loop/state machine.
- Solver verified levels 1–20 fully; 1–7, 9, 10, 12, 15–20 pass; 8/11/13/14 have since been redesigned but not re-verified. 21–35 need verification.
- Browser opens title screen with 0 console errors; screenshot taken at 1280×800 but not yet inspected.
- Dev server running in tmux at `http://localhost:3002`.

### Active
- Visual/functional QA of title screen and gameplay; fixing remaining level solvability and bugs.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Inspect latest screenshot `screenshots/title.jpg` for visual quality.
2. Re-run `node tools/verify.mjs` (A* solver, 1.5M budget) and fix failing frames (especially 8, 11, 13, 14, 21–35).
3. Play-test via `playwright-cli` (click PLAY, use `startLevel`/keyboard), check level 34 shock, level 13 frog/reset, level 35 ending wipe/reset.
4. Fix known bugs: sponsored-ad auto-respawn pause, adspace back-to-pause flow, assist implementation, HUD throttling, ambient switching, gem rendering.
5. Add/finish CSS for diamonds/vault/implode/reset/glitch overlays (already appended, needs verification); test mobile viewport.
6. Final README/assumption notes; ensure no console errors and all 35 frames solvable.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: DOM for all screens/HUD/touch/ad overlay.
- `styles.css`: full visual styling + diamond/vault/finale/reset/glitch CSS.
- `js/main.js`: loop, input, scenes, progression, ads, frog, finale, credits/diamonds.
- `js/levels.js`: 35 level definitions, `buildLevel`, gem generation.
- `js/physics.js`: shared deterministic player physics (`TILE=34`, jump 11.6).
- `js/render.js`: canvas backdrop, level/player/hazards/ads/frog/gems, glitch/shock/finale.
- `js/campaign.js`: brands, upgrades, objectives, creative drawing, ad math.
- `js/save.js`: save/load/wipe, skins, fresh defaults.
- `js/audio.js`: WebAudio SFX/ambience.
- `tools/verify.mjs`: A* physics solver/validator.
- `screenshots/title.jpg`: latest (uninspected) screenshot.

## Important Context
- Level 34 shock triggers once ever via `save.seen.shock34`; renderer `drawShock` draws ~0.2s crude bright phallus, no gameplay effect.
- Level 35 completion calls `startFinale()` → strobe → implode → `wipeProgress()` + terminal overlay → `location.reload()`; no completion screen, no save of clear.
- Level 13 is 30×56, par 160, has frog via `def.frog {x:18,y:5,triggerY:10,span:3.6,scale:3.2}`; frog contact calls `frogReset()` (full level reset, clears checkpoints, elapsed=0).
- Level 35 is 30×22, phase-alternating 2-wide platforms from bottom-left to top-right, `glitch:true`, `secret:true`.
- Solver command: `node tools/verify.mjs [id]`; add `DUMP=1` to print visited map. A* needs `f = depth*5 + dist/4.4` (greedy heuristic previously failed).
- Playwright config launches headed Chromium with Xvfb; `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002`, `screenshot --filename=...`.
- Game dev hook: `window.__illusion.startLevel(n)` (1-based) for testing.
